fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API Key
fields.helperText: Close API Key (generate in Close settings)

fields.name: base_url
fields.label: Address
fields.helperText: The API's base URL. Every request goes under it; a path outside it is refused.

options.label: API key in the query string
Google service account (ID token: Cloud Run, IAP)

fields.name: service_account_json
fields.label: Service account key (JSON)
fields.helperText: The JSON key file. Each request gets a short-lived Google token made from it; the key itself is never sent.

fields.name: scopes
fields.label: Scopes
fields.helperText: Separated by spaces or commas. Default: cloud-platform.

fields.name: subject
fields.label: Act as user (optional)
fields.helperText: Google Workspace APIs only: the user the service account acts for, with domain-wide delegation.

fields.name: audience
fields.label: Audience (optional)
fields.helperText: Who the ID token is for. Default: the address's origin, as Cloud Run expects. For IAP, the OAuth client ID.

fields.name: graphql
fields.label: GraphQL API
fields.helperText: On: a POST that only queries is a read; a mutation is a write.

fields.name: extra_headers
fields.label: Headers
fields.helperText: Optional. Sent with every request, e.g. Notion-Version. Not for keys: anyone who can see the connection sees them. The credential's header and transport headers cannot be set.

fields.name: test_path
fields.label: Test path
fields.helperText: Optional. A GET under the address that needs the credential, used by Test. With GraphQL on, Test sends { __typename } instead.

fields.name: test_expect
fields.label: Test expects
fields.helperText: Optional. A JSON field and the value Test needs in the answer, as path=value (e.g. ok=true, data.status=active). For APIs that report errors in a 200 body. Slack is checked for ok=true (on /auth.test unless a test path is set) by default.

fields.name: api_base_url
fields.label: API Base URL
fields.helperText: Base URL for PostHog API (e.g. https://us.posthog.com or https://eu.posthog.com)

fields.name: project_id
fields.label: Project ID
fields.helperText: PostHog Project ID (numeric)

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API Key
fields.helperText: Personal API key (recommended) or Project API key depending on Auth Type

fields.name: name
fields.label: Entity Name
fields.helperText: Name used as entity and collection name

fields.name: query
fields.label: HogQL Query
fields.placeholder: SELECT event, count() AS cnt FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - interval 7 day GROUP BY event ORDER BY cnt DESC
fields.helperText: Optional placeholders: $limit, $offset, and $since / {{since}}. If limit/offset are omitted, pagination will be appended automatically.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.label: Batch Size
fields.helperText: Number of records per request

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API Key
fields.helperText: Your Stripe secret API key

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API Token
fields.helperText: Wise personal API token or OAuth access token. Used as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

fields.name: profile_id
fields.label: Profile ID
fields.helperText: Optional. Restrict sync to one Wise profile. Leave blank to sync every profile the token can access.

fields.name: sca_private_key
fields.label: SCA Private Key
fields.helperText: Optional. PEM private key whose public key is registered in Wise (Settings → API tokens → Manage public keys). Wise asks for it (strong customer authentication) before it serves balance statements on some profiles.

fields.name: api_base_url
fields.label: API Base URL
fields.helperText: Production: https://api.wise.com. Sandbox: https://api.sandbox.transferwise.tech
